decisions.reason: A low-cost care accessory that complements the core flooring range, with little investment and no public commitment, but cheap to keep and supportive of the maintenance offer.
Maintenance oil is integral to the firm's oiled-floor system and announced surface-treatment options, so dropping it would undermine the system offer customers rely on.
Care products for oiled floors are tied to the firm's established floors and maintenance guidance, so management sees no reason to abandon this accessory.
The moisture-protection underlay is part of the flooring system the firm presents to installers and trade buyers, and its modest results can be attributed to start-up conditions.
The high-density underlay extends the accessory range at limited cost, and there is no evidence of failure that would justify removing it.
An oak parquet floor is the core of the firm's offer, backed by production investment and visible commitment, so dropping it is very unlikely.
